cargoProduct.title: Digital platform for end-to-end air cargo traceability
cargoProduct.description: Air Cargo centralizes events, integrations and operational evidence so every logistics stakeholder gets actionable visibility in near real time.
cargoProduct.heroTitle: Digitize your air cargo chain from warehouse to ramp.
cargoProduct.heroDescription: Air Cargo transforms fragmented email, spreadsheet and chat workflows into an event-driven operation with a control tower, shipment versioning and verifiable traceability. You get a single shipment timeline, exception alerts at critical checkpoints, and operational evidence for audits and faster decision-making. From pre-carriage and terminal intake to ULD build and ramp loading, every handoff is captured with standardized milestones, updated ETA signals, and exception traces that improve SLA performance, compliance, and coordination across shipper, forwarder, terminal, and carrier.
pillars: Control Tower with shipment timeline and exception alerting.
Standardized data model aligned with ONE Record and Cargo iQ milestones.
Auditable versioning for cubicage, flight or carrier changes without losing context.
outcomes: Reduces terminal and ramp blind spots with near-real-time operational evidence.
Cuts rework caused by misalignment across stakeholders and legacy systems.
Improves final customer confidence through reliable ETAs and status updates.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Direct answers to support an initial conversation.

items.question: Is J2O primarily focused on marketing websites or custom software?
items.answer: Our core focus is custom software: web and mobile applications, APIs, integrations, RFID and logistics solutions, and geospatial systems. Static sites and landing pages are also within our capabilities, but they are not the center of our offer.

items.question: Can you integrate Zebra devices, printers or ZPL label workflows?
items.answer: Yes. We can build solutions that include ZPL label printing, scanning workflows, logistics processes and operations supported by Zebra equipment.

items.question: Do you work with APIs and connected systems?
items.answer: Yes. We design and implement APIs, integrations and services to connect platforms, devices, applications and business processes.

items.question: Can you also build geospatial systems or map-based solutions?
items.answer: Yes. We can work with location-based workflows, territorial visualization, traceability, data layers and geospatial functionality according to project needs.
